g.text: Leash: hire a market maker, keep the leash
mint: the hook and what it protects · violet: the manager and its bond · grey: outside parties and Uniswap's own contracts · live on Unichain Sepolia
Leash hook 0xbB07…6880 · flags 0x2880 · no owner, admin, pause or upgrade
idle0, idle1 and fees per mandate;
count in only if both ends pass
one per block; spot near TWAP;
THE LEASH: inventory moves only between the hook and the pool, or back to the treasury.
The manager's two verbs, rebalance and setFee, take no recipient. It receives only its pay and its own bond, through claim.
